changes.summary: Bump Glide `minSdkVersion` to 23 to match AndroidX requirements.
Fix Javadoc style issue in `setMemoryCategoryInBackground` that was breaking Renovate tooling (Fixes #5680).
It should be safer to use Android's `ImageDecoder` (introduced in Android 9.0 Pie / API 28) with Glide on Android Q (API 29) and above.

Buffer Pooling**: Added support for allocating `ImageDecoder` ByteBuffers via Glide's `ArrayPool` to avoid double-allocation overhead (enabled via `setUseArrayPoolForImageDecoderByteBufferAllocation`).

changes.summary: Guava 33.7.1 removes the `Multi-Release` line from our jar manifest, fixing an issue under Java 9 and 10 that was introduced to `guava-jre` in [version 33.7.0].
### Newly introduced problem for Java 9 and Java 10 only
Guava 33.7.0 includes a `Multi-Release` line in its jar manifest, even though it is no longer a multi-release jar.
This causes [some problems with tools from Java 9 and Java 10].
Our Android `minSdkVersion` is now 24 (Nougat).

`collect`: Changed some `ImmutableMap` implementations to create a new, lightweight object on each call to view methods like `keySet()`, rather than creating and storing that object during the first call for reuse later.
`net`: Added `HttpHeaders` constant for `on-prefetch-activation`. (abd06a3679)
`net`: Added `MediaType` constants for `application/yaml` and `application/x-pem-file`. (a8e9533b49, 1d40e27a4b)

changes.summary: This slightly simplifies writing new tests with `ExpectFailure` and prevents future behavior changes in some `ExpectFailure` tests that already exist.
Our Android `minSdkVersion` is now 23 (Marshmallow).
Added more nullness information to our APIs (in the form of [JSpecify] annotations).
Please [report any problems]. (ee680cbaf)
Deprecated `Subject.Factory` methods for Java 8 types.
Please feel welcome to [open an issue] to report problems or request help.
Removed temporary type parameters from `Truth.assertThat(Stream)` and `Truth.assertThat(Optional)`.
This release deprecates `Truth8`.

While we do not plan to delete `Truth8`, we recommend migrating off it, at least if you static import `assertThat`: If you do not migrate, such static imports become ambiguous in Truth 1.4.2, breaking your build.
Please feel welcome to [open an issue] to report problems or request help.
Added the remaining `Truth8.assertThat` overloads to the main `Truth` class. (9be8e774c, 1f81827f1)
Added more `that` overloads to make it possible to write type-specific assertions when using the remaining Java 8 types. (7c65fc611)
For now, you may find that you need to make one kind of change, and you may elect to make others. (If we missed anything, please [open an issue] to report problems or request help.)
By adding new overloads of `Truth.assertThat`, we cause some code to fail to compile because of an overload ambiguity.
Alternatively, you may choose to wait until we make further changes to the new `Truth.assertThat` overloads.

Once we make those further changes, you may be able to simultaneously replace all your imports of `Truth8.assertThat` with imports of `Truth.assertThat` as you upgrade to the new version, likely without introducing overload ambiguities.
If you use `Truth8.assertThat(Stream)` or `Truth8.assertThat(Optional)`, you can migrate to the new overloads in `Truth`.
Made `StreamSubject` avoid collecting the `Stream` until necessary, and made its `isEqualTo` and `isNotEqualTo` methods no longer always throw. (f8ecaec69)
Added `assertThat` overloads for `Optional` and `Stream` to the main `Truth` class. (37fd8bea9)
Added `that` overloads to make it possible to write type-specific assertions when using `expect.that(optional)` and `expect.that(stream)`. (ca7e8f4c5)
There is no longer any need to depend on `truth-java8-extension`, which is now empty. (We've also removed the `Truth8` [GWT] module.) (eb0426eb7)
Again, if you have any problems, please [let us know].
Added `isWithin().of()` support to `IntegerSubject` and `LongSubject`. (6464cb5ca, 0e99a2711)
Affected users can already manually update their Guava dependency to 32.0.1, but if they don't depend directly on Guava, they may find it easier to upgrade to this new Truth release instead.
This means that it no longer runs under Java 7 VMs.
It continues to run under Android, even old versions, for all apps that have [enabled support for Java 8 language features]. (db5db2429)
Added support for `value of: method()` to `expect.that`, matching the existing support for `assertThat`. (bd8efd003)

changes.summary: Happy New Year! 2026 marks the ten year anniversary of this project, as I released the very first version all the way back in September 2016.

Therefore, please join me in celebration and welcome this new year by bumping both the plugin and instrumentation to a whole new major version, and a whole new name. `android-junit5` becomes `android-junit-framework`!! ✨
Going forward, this project is no longer tightly coupled to a particular version of the JUnit Framework.

Furthermore, both pieces of `android-junit-framework` are now compatible with JUnit 5 **and** 6. (Note that for JUnit 6, you need a baseline of Java 17, so your Android devices need to run API 35 or newer to make this happen.)

Removed deprecated `runComposeTest` API from `ComposeExtension`
New: Instead of silently skipping tests when running on unsupported devices, fail test execution via configuration parameter `de.mannodermaus.junit.unsupported.behavior`

changes.summary: ### Breaking changes and deprecations
Moved `Promise`-related functions from JS and Wasm/JS to the new `web` target.
On Wasm/JS, this is a breaking change.
Deprecated using `CoroutineDispatcher` as the coroutine context key; now, `ContinuationInterceptor` has to be used instead (#4333).
Advanced the deprecation levels on `kotlinx-coroutines-test` APIs (#4604).
Added lint functions that mark passing a `Job` to coroutine builders as deprecated (#4435).
Added a `callsInPlace(EXACTLY_ONCE)` contract to `runBlocking` in code shared between JVM and Native (#4368).
Added a `callsInPlace(EXACTLY_ONCE)` contract to `suspendCancellableCoroutine` (#4574).
Added `CompletableDeferred.asDeferred` for obtaining a read-only `Deferred` view (#4408).
Added `SharedFlow.asFlow` for obtaining a `Flow` view with hidden hot flow semantics (#4530).
Added a `StateFlow.collectLatest` overload returning `Nothing` to assist with finding unreachable code (#4454).
Added `ReceiveChannel.consumeTo` for consuming a `ReceiveChannel` into a `MutableCollection` (#4520).
Added a `StateFlow<T>.onSubscription` overload returning a `StateFlow<T>`, similar to `SharedFlow<T>.onSubscription` returning `SharedFlow<T>` (#4275).
Added terminal `Flow` operators for collecting a `Flow` to a `Map` (#1541).

changes.summary: This version also includes new node insertion methods for `Elements`, and DOM mutations now reject operations that would create a cycle.
Improved `W3CDom` XML conversion to retain processing instructions, comments outside the root element, and CDATA sections, which were previously dropped or converted to text. <small>[#2572]</small>
Added `Elements#before(Node)`, `after(Node)`, `prepend(Node)`, and `append(Node)` to match the existing HTML string methods. <small>[#953]</small>

Large file-backed uploads through `Connection.requestBodyStream(InputStream)` now stream directly with the JDK `HttpClient` on Java 11+, rather than being loaded fully into memory first. <small>[#2575]</small>

Extended Java 11+ HTTP client reuse from requests sharing a `Jsoup.newSession()` to ordinary `Jsoup.connect()` calls, reducing transport thread and connection setup churn under sustained request loads.
Attributes added after parsing, or included through subtree conversion, now use inherited prefix declarations.
Attributes that still cannot be represented are skipped, and unrepresentable elements no longer change the surrounding tree.

Aligned RCDATA, RAWTEXT, and script-data parsing with the HTML specification: malformed end tags no longer consume following markup, unclosed `title`/`textarea` content stays text through EOF, and custom text tags match exact names. <small>
Source-tracked DOMs retain 58-65% less memory on representative medium-to-large documents, and the improvements hold under concurrent parsing without introducing new contention.
This release also fixes a [security issue in the Cleaner] that could expose markup when malformed HTML is cleaned with a custom `Safelist` permitting certain raw-text elements.
Added `Element#classList()`, an immutable snapshot of an element's class names in attribute order.

Improved redirect credential handling as a defense-in-depth measure: explicit authorization headers and request cookies are no longer forwarded across origins, reducing exposure through open redirects and aligning with HTTP guidance.
Cleaned up the Maven build for the multi-release JAR so Java 8 and Java 11+ sources compile as separate source sets.
Expanded and clarified `NodeTraversor` support for in-place DOM rewrites during `NodeVisitor.head()`.

Updated the default HTML `TagSet` for current HTML elements: added `dialog`, `search`, `picture`, and `slot`; made `ins`, `del`, `button`, `audio`, `video`, and `canvas` inline by default (`Tag#isInline()`, aligned to phrasing content in th
Android (R8/ProGuard): added a rule to ignore the optional `re2j` dependency when not present. <small>[#2459]</small>
Parsing during charset sniffing no longer fails if an advisory `available()` call throws `IOException`, as seen on JDK 8 `HttpURLConnection`. <small>[#2474]</small>
`Cleaner` no longer makes relative URL attributes in the input document absolute when cleaning or validating a `Document`.
`Cleaner` no longer duplicates enforced attributes when the input `Document` preserves attribute case.
Migrated the integration test server from Jetty to Netty, which actively maintains support for our minimum JDK target (8). <small>[#2491]</small>
jsoup 1.22.1** is out now, adding support for the `re2j` regular expression engine for regex-based CSS selectors, a configurable maximum parser depth, and numerous bug fixes and improvements.
Added support for using the `re2j` regular expression engine for regex-based CSS selectors (e.g. `[attr~=regex]`, `:matches(regex)`), which ensures linear-time performance for regex evaluation.

Added an instance method `Parser#unescape(String, boolean)` that unescapes HTML entities using the parser's configuration (e.g. to support error tracking), complementing the existing static utility `Parser.unescapeEntities(String, boolean)`
Added a configurable maximum parser depth (to limit the number of open elements on stack) to both HTML and XML parsers.
Build: added CI coverage for JDK 25 <small>[#2403]</small>
Build: added a CI fuzzer for contextual fragment parsing (in addition to existing full body HTML and XML fuzzers). [oss-fuzz #14041]
Set a removal schedule of jsoup 1.24.1 for previously deprecated APIs.
Null characters in the HTML body were not consistently removed; and in foreign content were not correctly replaced. <small>[#2395]</small>

Custom tags marked as `Tag.Void` now parse and serialize like the built-in void elements: they no longer consume following content, and the XML serializer emits the expected self-closing form. <small>[#2425]</small>
`TagSet` copies no longer mutate their template during lazy lookups, preventing cross-thread `ConcurrentModificationException` when parsing with shared sessions. <small>[#2453]</small>
Deprecated internal helper `org.jsoup.internal.Functions` (for removal in v1.23.1).

This was previously used to support older Android API levels without full `java.util.function` coverage; jsoup now requires core library desugaring so this indirection is no longer necessary. <small>[#2412]</small>
jsoup 1.21.2** is out now, adding support for custom `SSLContext` in HTTP/2 connections, and improving consistency in how user data is handled in attributes.
Deprecated internal (yet visible) methods `Normalizer#normalize(String, bool)` and `Attribute#shouldCollapseAttribute(Document.OutputSettings)`.
These will be removed in a future version.
Deprecated `Connection#sslSocketFactory(SSLSocketFactory)` in favor of the new `Connection#sslContext(SSLContext)`.
Added `Connection#sslContext(SSLContext)` to provide a custom SSL (TLS) context to requests, supporting both the `HttpClient` and the legacy `HttUrlConnection` implementations. <small>[#2370]</small>
In `NodeTraversor`, if a last child element was removed during the `head()` call, the parent would be visited twice. <small>[#2355]</small>.

changes.summary: enable LIMIT support for UPDATE and DELETE ([acf84ae]), closes [#1318]
update deprecated action ([ce63cd4])
reintroduce improved support for Statement#getGeneratedKeys ([f7d49f6])
🚨 remove support for Statement#getGeneratedKeys: *getGeneratedKeys is not supported anymore* ([712a8a5]), closes [#329]
🚨 remove the deprecated SQLiteJDBCLoader isPureJavaMode and getPureJavaFlag: *methods are removed* ([e52c44f])
🚨 remove the deprecated TransactionMode.DEFFERED: *no more backward compatibility when using the deprecated enum value* ([8967d75])
add support for LocalDate, LocalTime, LocalDateTime in ResultSet#getObject ([1d2ff63])
replace jdk 19 with 20 ([0c5a645])
use markdown for SECURITY.md because Github doesn't support Asciidoc ([00e9c3f])
sqlite**: add support for legacy_alter_table flag ([26df15f]), closes [#481]
database from jar resource no longer keeps the jar file-descriptor open ([38c25af])
replace java 18 with java 19 ([4c80ee7])
changelog shows breaking change description ([5ad78ba]), closes [#814]
🚨 enable new math functions: _previously log() computed the natural logarithm, now it computes a base-10 logarithm_ ([0f41f46])
replace deprecated set-output usage ([7ee209c])
jdbc**: add support for DatabaseMetaData#getSearchStringEscape
[0ede2be] [jdbc] support for read-only transactions, fix timeout handling
[0795636] add support for Linux musl x86 32bits
[062440a] build on jdk 17 (#747)
Removed outdated version of OSInfo.class
## New Features
Dropped DragonFlyBSD support (#641)
Added CI for testing JDK16 compatibility. sqlite-jdbc works for JDK8 to JDK16
